title: Pickup-Weekday Multiple for Late Cancellation Fees — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
On a late-cancelled Bluegate Moving Truck Rental reservation, the cancellation peak-day multiple depends on the weekday of the scheduled pickup date: a Saturday or Sunday pickup multiplies the cancellation fee by **1.5**, a Friday pickup by **1.25**, and a pickup on any other weekday by one.

| Weekday of the scheduled pickup date | Multiple applied to the cancellation fee |
|---|---|
| Monday | 1 |
| Tuesday | 1 |
| Wednesday | 1 |
| Thursday | 1 |
| Friday | 1.25 |
| Saturday | 1.5 |
| Sunday | 1.5 |

## Points of reading

- The weekday is that of the scheduled pickup date on the reservation, not the weekday on which the cancellation is made.
- A reservation whose scheduled pickup is Thursday 23:30 takes the multiple of one; one scheduled for Friday 00:30 takes 1.25.
- Illustration (hypothetical): a cancellation fee of 25.00 on a reservation scheduled for a Sunday pickup becomes 37.50; the same fee on a Friday pickup becomes 31.25.
